notes:
Summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app coaching). Started on Hosted API for fast iteration; now evaluating Dedicated for production stability and data residency.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- "We want dev velocity from hosted but can't have customer PII leave EU data centers" (CTO).
- "If we can get predictable P95 <120ms for chat and <250ms for batch embeddings we'll consider reserved capacity" (Head of Product).

Technical priorities / requirements (shorthand):
- EU-only residency: data at rest + logs must remain in EU, separate KMS for keys, audit trail.
- Multi-region routing: prefer primary eu-central (Frankfurt), failover to eu-west (Amsterdam) only for regional outage; ask about cross-region KV cache warm-up time (~40-80ms observed in initial tests).
- Latency targets: interactive chat p95 target 80-120ms during peak; background embedding jobs tolerate 200-300ms but need high throughput (50+ reqs/s).
- Model preferences: tuned open LlamaRef variants acceptable; want ability to pin model versions and automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant for cost spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; interested in Optimize suggestions (batching + KV caching) to lower per-token costs.

POC plan discussed:
- Short-term: run Hosted API in eu-central with synthetic traffic; capture p50/p95, tails, and egress patterns.
- Medium-term: 2-week Dedicated trial in eu-central (reserved pool), measure steady-state latency and cost delta.
- Legal: add EU residency appendix; confirm KMS integration and audit log retention window.

Open concerns / SE notes:
- Multi-region routing adds ~40-60ms tail (warm-cache vs cold). Emberfield wants a config knob to prefer local-only routing for GDPR-sensitive tenants.
- Need clear egress & inter-region pricing example for their 35% cross-region failover budget assumption.
- Caching behavior: they will test prefix caching for common prompts (support-agent templates).

Next steps (short):
- Send dedicated quote + capacity plan (Sofia) by 2026-02-24.
use_case_summary: Product in-app coaching + support assistant. POC uses hosted for development then move to Dedicated for predictability and EU residency. Primary flows: short interactive chat (customer support and product guidance), vector search on user docs, and reranking for suggestions.
technical_requirements: P95 chat <120ms (target), embedding throughput 50+ reqs/s, EU-only data at rest, separate EU KMS + audit logs, canary rollouts, automatic fallback to quantized variant on capacity constraints.
commercial_notes: Prefers consumption for hosted, committed monthly for Dedicated. Looking at 12-18 month reserved capacity with option to burst. PAIN: procurement window closes end of Q1. Wants credit/backstop for overage during onboarding.
competitive_landscape_notes: Evaluating Redwood vs direct cloud endpoints and open-source self-hosting. Concerned about total cost vs OpenAI; interested in Redwood's Optimize recommendations and transparent per-route cost breakdowns.
last_meeting_summary: 2026-02-15 legal + SE sync. Legal provided residency checklist; SE agreed to run EU-frankfurt dedicated micro-benchmark. Action: Redwood to provide sample contract clause for EU-only data handling and draft dedicated pricing by 2026-02-24.
